subject: Charged twice and now I can't get in
body: I was charged twice this month for my Pro plan and now I can't log in to check my account. This is really frustrating. Please fix the double charge.
notes: The real problem is a duplicate charge (billing). The login complaint is a symptom. The router latches onto 'can't log in' and misroutes to technical, so the pipeline retrieves login docs and produces a clean, confident answer to the wrong problem. Every in-loop check passes.
